description: This file manages the addition and deletion of products in an e-commerce admin panel. It handles form input for adding new products, including uploading images, sanitizing input data, checking for existing products, inserting new records into the database, and deleting products along with their images and associated cart/wishlist entries. It also displays a list of existing products with options to update or delete each one.
